what: The Round builder cannot be scrolled by touch, and its Start button sits below the screen on common phones. `.sheet{touch-action:none}` (line 466) blocks touch panning on the sheet, which is itself the scroll container (`.sheet{max-height:86vh;overflow:auto}`, line 524). On 360×640 and 375×667 (iPhone SE), even a brand-new user's 6-leg sheet puts #rbBuild at y≈814 on a 640/667 px screen. With a weak leg and due patterns (8 legs) it is off-screen at 390×844 too. On a phone you cannot start the Round, the app's main action.
evidence: Measured #rbBuild bottom: 360×640 → 814; 375×667 → 817; 390×844 with 8 legs → 952. Touch swipe via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent on the sheet: scrollTop stays 0. After setting style.touchAction='pan-y' the same swipe scrolls 124 px. Page-body swipe (control) scrolls 471 px. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-360x640.png
fix: Set `.sheet{touch-action:pan-y}`, and keep the swipe-to-close only on .sheet-grab, or only when scrollTop===0. Make the Start/Cancel row a sticky footer (`position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--surface)`) so the primary action is always visible.

what: On phone the severity table overflows: the 'Severity' column starts at x = 350 inside a 306 px wide .tw box (scrollWidth 420), so the whole Severity column (the point of the table) is invisible with no scroll cue.
evidence: Playwright 390×844, openLesson('asthma'): .tw clientWidth 306, scrollWidth 420; th[1] left 350. Screenshot shots/T06-asthma-phone-answered.png shows only the Finding column.
fix: Under 480 px let .tbl cells wrap (white-space:normal; th/td min-width:0) and give the first column ~65% width, or stack rows as 'Severity: finding' cards; at minimum add a right-edge fade/scroll hint on .tw when scrollWidth > clientWidth.

where: .sheet { touch-action:none } on the OCR confirm sheet
what: The OCR sheet reuses .sheet, which sets touch-action:none, and the sheet is a scroll container (max-height 86vh, overflow:auto). On a 390×844 phone the sheet content is 1063 px tall in a 724 px box, and 'Use these numbers' sits at y = 1168, below the screen. touch-action:none on the scroll container disables touch panning, so on a real phone the user probably cannot swipe down to the buttons. Headless Chromium could not synthesise touch scrolling even with touch-action:auto, so please confirm this on a phone.
evidence: t12/ux.py: phone {sh:1063, ch:724, ok-button bottom:1168, vh:844, touchAction:'none'}. Mouse-wheel scrolling works (scrollTop 339).
fix: Add `.ocrsheet{touch-action:pan-y;overscroll-behavior:contain}`, or limit touch-action:none to the .sheet-grab handle. Make the button row sticky at the bottom of the sheet (`position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--surface)`), so the action is always visible.

what: On a phone, the gas slip and vignette scroll off-screen as soon as you reach step 3–4. To answer the gap, Δ ratio or oxygenation questions, the user has to scroll back up for Na/Cl/albumin/PaO2, then down again for every step.
evidence: 390×844, clinical light, startSession('steps') at level 3, answer 3 steps: the slip is not visible while 'Anion gap (corrected for albumin)?' is asked. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T17-phone-steps-mid.png
fix: Under 700px, make the slip a compact sticky strip (pH / PCO2 / HCO3 / Na / Cl / Alb / PaO2 in one or two mono lines) at the top of the session card, or add a 'Show gas' floating button that opens the slip in a sheet. Keep it visible while answering.

what: .web-svg has min-width 760px, but the layout is 1287×1277 user units. On a 390 px phone the map scrolls sideways inside a 338 px card and the 12-unit labels render at about 7 px, which cannot be read. There is no zoom or pan, and the bottom nav covers part of the map.
evidence: Phone 390×844: svg 760×754 px, wrap clientWidth 338, scrollWidth 772. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-phone-web-co.png
fix: On narrow screens, add a list fallback (topics → nodes → links, which the detail card already supports), or pinch-zoom/pan on the SVG with the selected node centred. At minimum, set min-width to about 1100px so the text is about 11 px, and centre the scroll on the selected node.

what: On a 390 px phone the debrief key-step table (.tbl min-width:420px, no scroll wrapper) pushes the page to 462 px wide: horizontal page scroll and the 'You' column sits outside its card.
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T22-vent-debrief-phone-dark.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T22-vent-debrief-phone-clin-light.png are 462/461 px wide at viewport 390.
fix: Wrap the table in <div class="tblwrap" style="overflow-x:auto"> in simDebrief (ui8.js) or add '.card .tbl{min-width:0}' with word wrapping for the Target column ('by 120 min' on one line via white-space:nowrap).

what: The built single file has no <!doctype html> and no <meta charset="utf-8">. Opened directly (file://, or any plain HTTP server that sends no charset), Chromium sometimes guesses windows-1252: every non-ASCII character becomes mojibake (PaO₂ → PaOâ‚‚, K⁺ → Kâº, ' · ' → 'Â·', the 🔥 streak pill garbled) and the page runs in quirks mode (document.compatMode = BackCompat). Worse, Yuzu packs and backups copied in that state contain the corrupted text permanently.
evidence: Frozen copy opened 8 times by file://: 1 of 8 loads came up as document.characterSet 'windows-1252', and pack('a','b',[]).category returned 'Medicine::Physiology::Acidâ€“Base'. The exported lesson.json bytes for 'Acid–Base' were c3 a2 e2 82 ac e2 80 9c (double-encoded). Served from python http.server it is garbled every time: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-google-localhost.png ('PaOâ‚‚', 'Kâº', 'Â·'). pwa/index.html does have the charset, but buffer.html does not.
fix: Start shell.html (or the wrapper in build.py) with '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">', placed before the base64 font so it falls inside the first 1024 bytes. Check the CSS still behaves in standards mode.

what: While a Round is running, the round bar covers the phone tab bar completely, so there is no bottom navigation. Two causes: (1) the phone rule `#roundbar{bottom:calc(64px + env(...))}` (line 88) is declared before the base rule `#roundbar{position:fixed;...;bottom:0}` (line 473), which wins; (2) nav.tabs is a child of header.top (sticky, z-index 20), so its z-index 25 only counts inside the header and #roundbar (z 24) paints over it. The bar is also 115 px tall at 390 px (it wraps to two rows) while main gets only 92 px bottom padding, so the last card on every page is partly hidden.
evidence: 390×844 and 360×640: build a Round (Today → Start the Round → Start), then go('learn'). Measured: tabs top 781, roundbar 729–844 (360: 553–640). Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-roundbar-learn-390.png and -360.png: no tab bar visible, last module card cut by the bar.
fix: Move the phone #roundbar rule below the base rule (or raise its specificity), lower #roundbar to z-index 19 or move nav.tabs out of header.top on phone. Make the bar one row on phone (hide .pips and the label under 420 px, keep Go/Skip/✕), and set `body.inround main{padding-bottom:calc(92px + <bar height>)!important}` inside the same media query.

what: Wide lesson tables scroll inside .tw, but nothing shows that they scroll: touch scrollbars are invisible and there is no fade or hint. On the RTA lesson the table has four columns (Type 1, 2 and 4); at 390 px only Type 1 and half of Type 2 show, cut mid-word ('Cannot reclaim HCO', 'Usually 12–2'), and Type 4 is never seen. Same for the compensation table (Limit and Time columns hidden) and the interpreter formulas table.
evidence: openLesson('rta') at 390×844: .tw scrollWidth 458 vs clientWidth 306. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-lesson-rta-390x844-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-lesson-comp-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Add a scroll affordance to .tw: `background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--surface) 30%,transparent) left/24px 100% no-repeat local, linear-gradient(to left,var(--surface) 30%,transparent) right/24px 100% no-repeat local, radial-gradient(farthest-side at 100% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.35),transparent) right/10px 100% no-repeat scroll` plus a small 'Swipe →' caption when scrollWidth > clientWidth. Better for 3+ column tables under 560 px: stack rows as cards (`.tbl.stack td::before{content:attr(data-th)}`).

where: .tw table wrapper at phone width (lessons learn, otherbuf, henry)
what: At 390 px the three-column tables are wider than the card (scrollWidth 420 vs clientWidth 306), and the third column is clipped mid-word with no sign that it scrolls (no visible scrollbar on mobile). In the learn lesson the hidden column is 'In Buffer', the column that matters most.
evidence: Phone 390×844: openLesson('otherbuf') → /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T02-otherbuf-table-phone.png. On the learn lesson, TABLE.tbl's right edge is at 462 px.
fix: Below 600 px, stack .tbl rows into cards (td::before{content:attr(data-th)}), or at least add a right-edge fade and 'swipe →' hint on .tw when scrollWidth > clientWidth.

what: Every lesson table (npo2, ncoox, nderived, nall, vbg, hagma, nagma, malk, racid, mixed, oxread, glance) is 420-450 px wide inside a 306 px scroll box. Text is cut mid-word ('Hyperchloraemic normal AG acido', 'Intercha') with no shadow, fade or hint that it scrolls sideways. On the VBG table the whole 'Clinically' column, which carries the take-home message, is hidden.
fix: Under 480px either stack table rows as cards (each td on its own line, with the th as a label via data-label) or add a right-edge fade gradient plus a 'swipe' hint. Drop min-width on two-column tables.

what: The 'one printable screen' pocket card prints on 2 A4 pages in a single column with large empty space and no title (print CSS hides .view-head).
evidence: page.pdf A4 of Pocket card -> 2 pages, single column, page 1 ends after 'Gaps' with ~30% blank. /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/t14/dk-1.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/t14/dk-2.png
fix: In @media print: .pocket{display:block;columns:2;column-gap:10mm;font-size:9pt} .pocket .card{padding:6px} and add a print-only header 'Buffer · blood-gas pocket card · printed dd/mm/yyyy'. Aim for one A4 side.

what: Print sets body colour to black but card backgrounds keep the dark-theme surface, so with 'Background graphics' on the text is black on near-black.
evidence: Dark theme, page.pdf(print_background=True) -> almost unreadable cards: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/t14/pdf-1.png. Computed print styles: td colour rgb(0,0,0), card background rgb(22,17,13).
fix: In @media print set .card,.ro,.tbl td{background:#fff!important;color:#000!important} and eyebrow colour to a dark orange (#B4470B).

what: The results strip reuses the class .hrow, which is the site header row (line 63; <header class="top"><div class="wrap hrow">). The speed rule '.hrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}' is global, so it overrides the header gap (10px → 4px) and lets the header wrap on narrow screens.
fix: Rename the strip class (e.g. .sphist) in ui7.js speedDone() and shell.html line 550.

what: Likely flash of the wrong theme on load. The CSS default (:root) is the light palette and the app default is dark, but data-theme is only set by applyTheme() after ~700 KB of inline script has parsed (the first <script> is at byte 61,859 and the markup comes before it). On a slow phone with the OS in light mode, the first paint is probably cream, then it flips to dark. I did not capture the frame, so this is unconfirmed.
evidence: Byte offsets in buffer-4.9.0.html: markup ends at about 61 KB and applyTheme runs at the end of a 769 KB file.
fix: Add a tiny inline script in <head>: try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('buffer.v1')||'{}');const t=s.theme||'dark';if(t!=='auto')document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t;document.documentElement.dataset.skin=s.skin==='clinical'?'clinical':'pixel';}catch(e){document.documentElement.dataset.theme='dark'}

what: Small text contrast is below WCAG AA in light themes (both skins). --muted #75685A on --surface-2 #EDE3D0 is 4.25:1 (segmented buttons, the teaching-only banner, interp step text). The eyebrow (--accent-ink #B9480A) on --bg #F3EBDD is 4.44:1 at about 10 px. The session 'Hint' label (--warn #A86A00 on --warn-soft, 9 px) is 3.63:1.
evidence: An automated contrast scan of 12 views × 4 skin/theme combinations at 390×844 found 0 failures in either dark theme (apart from the next finding) and 1–30 per view in light: lesson 'comp' 30, Learn 21, Today 19, interp 19. Ratios computed from the computed colours.
fix: In the light palette, darken --muted to #6A5D50 (5.0:1 on surface-2) and --accent-ink to #A23F08 (5.1:1). Use --fg2 for .hint b, or raise it to 11 px bold.

where: interp step list li > i (dark themes)
what: In the dark theme, the interpreter's step numbers are white on lime (#84CC16, 1.98:1) and on amber (#E3B860, 1.86:1), which fails contrast.
evidence:
openTool('interp') in dark mode:
  • 1 has color #fff on background rgb(132,204,22).
fix: In dark themes set the colour of li.ok>i, li.warn>i and li.bad>i to var(--on-accent) (#0B0907).

what: The Settings controls are small for touch (the user's main devices are a Steam Deck and a Samsung tablet). The skin and theme buttons are 48–64 × 29 px with 10 px pixel-font labels. The Quiet mode checkbox is a 13 × 13 px native checkbox in browser blue, the only blue control in the Orange UI. The 'Advanced' summary in Google & Citrus is a tiny 9 px label.
evidence: Measured at 390×844: pixel 50×29, clinical 64×29, auto 48×29 (font 10px), sQuiet 13×13. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-settings-desk-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Give .seg buttons in Settings min-height:40px and 12–13 px text. Replace the checkbox with the app's switch or seg (On/Off), or at least set accent-color:var(--accent) with a 22 px box. Make summary.adv a normal button-styled row.

what: On a 390 px phone the compensation-rules table clips its third column ('LIMIT' shows 'PCO', '10–1', 'HCO') in all four skin/theme combinations. If the table scrolls sideways, nothing shows that it does. This belongs to the Learn owners, but I saw it on every skin.
fix: Wrap lesson tables in a container with overflow-x:auto and a right-edge fade, or stack the rows into cards below 480 px.

what: The 4.6 chat-bubble rule `.bub{max-width:…;padding:8px 12px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);display:grid}` also hits the brand logo `.brand .bub`. The logo square becomes 28×22 with a grey border and padding instead of the 22×22 orange pixel bubble, on every screen and in both skins.
evidence: Computed at 1280×800: .brand .bub offsetWidth 28, height 22, padding 8px 12px, border 2px, display grid. Visible in every header shot, e.g. /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-today-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Rename the chat bubble class (e.g. .cbub in ui8.js caseBubble and the CSS at line 555–556), or scope it as `.chat .bub`.

what: Segments given `class="seg wrap"` (case filters, glossary filter, gas-log tags, Davenport/vent/lung scenario pickers) also get the page container rule `.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding-left/right:16px}`. They are centred instead of left-aligned and have 16 px of empty padding before the first button; Presentation wraps 'On the ventilator' onto a lonely second row.
evidence: go('cases') at 1280×800: Format/Setting/Exam segs centred, Presentation full width with inner padding. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-cases-1280x800-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-model-dav-1280x800-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-gloss-1280x800-pixel-dark.png. Used in e3.js (5), ui8.js (2), ui6.js, ui9.js.
fix: Rename the modifier to `.seg.wrapping` (or `.seg-wrap`) in shell.html line 539 and the 9 call sites. .seg already has flex-wrap:wrap, so the modifier can simply be removed.

what: The unit converter's ⇄ cell uses class .eq, which also matches the formula-box rule `.eq{background;border:2px;border-left:5px solid var(--accent);padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 12px}`. The swap control looks like a stray formula block, sits 12 px higher than the inputs and has an orange left bar.

what: The 4.4 history-row rule `.hrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}` (line 550) overrides the header row `.hrow` (line 63): the header gap drops from 10 px to 4 px and the header may wrap. The streak chip sits 4 px from the gear button.
evidence: Computed header .hrow at 1280×800: gap 4px, flex-wrap wrap.
fix: Rename the 4.4 class (e.g. `.hist`) in ui7.js/ui3.js/ui9.js and line 550.

where: .autopsy (4.6 override of the session 'Why the miss?' row)
what: `.autopsy{display:grid;gap:6px;margin:6px 0 10px}` (line 560, added for cases) overrides the original chip row `.autopsy{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}`. After a wrong answer in any session the four reasons are now full-width dashed rows, 172 px tall, pushing the next question down.
evidence: startSession('quick'), answer wrong at 390×844: .autopsy display grid, height 172 px. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-autopsy-390.png.
fix: Scope the 4.6 rule to the case view (`#v-cases .autopsy`) or delete it; keep the chip row.

what: The embedded pixel font has 121 glyphs and lacks ₂ ₃ ⁺ ⁻ ~ ÷ ′ ≤ ≥ Δ ⇄ and others. Text set in --px falls back to ui-monospace/Menlo (DejaVu on Linux) for those characters, so headings and readouts mix two fonts: 'Ventilator CO₂' (big fallback 2), 'HCO₃⁻ 42 mmol/L. Expected PCO₂?', the weekly '~367' reads like '~-367', timeline '0′', '[H⁺] from pH' reads as 'DH⁺]'.
evidence: Glyph list read from the woff with fontTools. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-tool-vent-390x844-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-progress-390x844-pixel-dark.png (~-367), /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-sess-gym-390x844-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Add the glyphs to the font (sub/superscript 0–9, + −, ~, ÷, ′, ≤ ≥, Δ). Until then, set the fallback stack for --px to a font with matching metrics and wrap sub/superscripts in pixel contexts with `<span class="sx">` using `font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.8em`.

what: The waveform SVG (viewBox 320×120, width:100%) scales with the card: 972×365 px at 1280+ wide. The '30' limit label and 'airway pressure, 2 breaths' render at about 30 px, and the readouts are pushed below the fold. At 1440 in the clinical skin it looks like a stretched placeholder.
evidence: openTool('m-vent'): svg 306×115 at 390, 972×365 at 1280 and 1920. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-model-vent-1280x800-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-model-vent-1440x900-clinical-light.png.
fix: Cap it: `.ventw{max-height:180px}` with preserveAspectRatio='none' on the plot group and vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke, or build the viewBox from the element width in e3.js so labels stay 10–11 px.

what: At 360 px the printout table wraps: '+13.9' and its 'H' flag split onto two lines and the reference '7.35–7.45' breaks over two lines, so rows lose alignment.
fix: `.slip td{white-space:nowrap}` and hide the reference column under 380 px (`@media(max-width:380px){.slip td:nth-child(4){display:none}}`), as .fitc already does.

what: The 4.1 44 px rule skipped segmented buttons. .seg button is about 30 px tall (padding 7px, 10 px font): difficulty, gases per session, Arterial/Venous, confidence (Sure/Think/Guess), case filters, theme and skin pickers.
fix: Add `.seg button{min-height:44px}` to the 4.1 block (or 40 px with 2 px gap).

where: light theme tokens (--accent as text, --muted on --surface-2)
what: Light theme contrast fails WCAG AA for small text in several places: --accent #F26A1B on --surface is 2.84:1 (used as text in .qk b, .hero-legs li::before, .method6 counters, .lvlpill .num); --muted on --surface-2 and on --accent-soft is 4.25:1 (9 px .mt small, .keys dt, .badge-tile, .teachbar); .hint b (--warn on --warn-soft) is 3.63:1 at 9 px.
evidence: Computed from the tokens on :root (relative luminance formula). Dark theme passes everywhere checked (muted 6.4:1).

where: type scale (9–10 px text, both skins)
what: Much of the interface is 9–10 px: phone tab labels (9 px), .tile small.meta, .mt small, .tbl th, .keys dt, .legend, .hint b, .conf, .hintbtn, .stats small, eyebrows (10 px). The audit found 9 px text in 56 of 66 views at 390 px. In the clinical skin --px becomes Atkinson, so the same sizes are tiny body text, and tile titles (.tile b, 12 px) are smaller than their descriptions (13.6 px).
evidence: Audit across all views (getComputedStyle font-size < 11.5 px). Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-practice-1440x900-clinical-light.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-today-390x844-clinical-light.png.
fix: Floor small pixel text at 10 px and body text at 12 px. Add a clinical scale: `html[data-skin=clinical] .eyebrow,.tile small.meta,.mt small,.tbl th,.chip,.seg button,nav.tabs button{font-size:12px}` and `html[data-skin=clinical] .tile b{font-size:15px}`.

what: The built file starts with <title> and has no <!doctype html>, <meta charset> or viewport meta. Opened as a file, it renders in quirks mode (document.compatMode 'BackCompat'), and in 2 of about 20 headless launches Chromium decoded it as windows-1252, giving mojibake everywhere ('ðŸ”¥', 'Â·', 'Guillainâ€"BarrÃ©'). The PWA index.html is fine. Probably harmless inside the artifact wrapper, but any direct open of buffer.html is at risk. (Doubt: frequency depends on the browser's encoding guess.)
evidence: Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-today-390x844-pixel-light.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-autopsy-390.png show the mojibake; document.compatMode = BackCompat in every run.
fix: If the artifact host allows it, prepend `<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">`, or have build.py write a separate standalone copy with them.

what: Small primary buttons are 10px. In the pixel skin that is the pixel font, but in the clinical skin it is Atkinson at 10px, much smaller than the 13.76px secondary button next to it. This affects plan items (including the long night-shift sentence), 'Read it step by step', 'Review now' and weak-spot buttons.
fix: Add `html[data-skin=clinical] .btn.primary.small{font-size:.86rem}`. In both skins, use the regular font for plan rows (.planl .btn.primary{font-family:inherit;font-size:.86rem}), because they are sentences, not labels.

what: Plan rows have ragged right edges: the button width depends on the width of the minutes label ('25 min' vs '4 min' vs '1 min'). On desktop the full-width bars with tiny left-aligned text look like progress bars.
fix: Give `.planl li small{min-width:4.5em;text-align:right}`. On ≥820px, cap the plan width or lay the items out as a numbered checklist with the minutes inside the row.

what: In the dark theme, the Round bar is a cream (var(--ink)) slab with dark text, the only light surface on a dark screen. It holds three buttons ('Go', 'Skip leg', '✕') plus the label, and takes ~115px on a phone above the content. '✕' stops the whole Round without confirmation, right next to 'Skip leg'.
fix: Use var(--surface-2) with an accent top border in dark. Collapse to one line on phones (pips + label + ⋯ menu holding Skip/Stop). Ask to confirm Stop, or offer Undo in the toast.

what: The builder uses native checkboxes in the browser's default blue, which clash with the orange accent in both skins. The sheet title 'Build today's Round' is the 10px muted pixel label, smaller than the row text.
fix: Add `.sheet input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--accent);width:22px;height:22px}` and make the sheet title an h2 at about 18px.

what: The rule .qitem>p{font-weight:700} also matches the explanation paragraph p.why, so every explanation is bold in its full length. This makes long explanations tiring to read and leaves no contrast for the bold 'Correct.' / 'Not quite.' label.
fix: Change it to .qitem>p:not(.why){font-weight:700} (or add .why{font-weight:400}).

what: Long formulas wrap mid-expression ('= 25 × 0.261 =' / '6.5'; 'SIDe = … =' / '20.6') even at 1280 px, because the lesson body is narrow and the monospace text is large.
fix: Give .eq white-space:pre (overflow-x:auto already exists), or split each formula into 'definition' and 'with numbers' lines in c4.js.

what: The 'Lesson complete' toast sits over the pager (Next button) and the Sources card at the bottom of the phone screen, exactly where the learner's thumb goes next.
fix: On narrow screens, raise the toast above the pager or show it at the top, and auto-dismiss it in 2 s.

what: At 390 px the 3–5 column tables (lactate types, toxalc, hypox, respfail, odc, ratios) are clipped mid-word ('seizu', 'Metformin, salbu') with no sign they scroll sideways. hypox loses most of the Examples column.
fix: Add a right-edge fade/shadow on overflow (background-attachment:local gradients) and a small 'swipe →' hint, or stack rows as cards under 480 px.

where: rta and other .tw tables at 390 px
what: On phone the RTA table scrolls horizontally inside .tw with no visual cue; the Type 4 column — the one with the key bold 'High' K⁺ — is entirely off-screen and easy to miss. Same in traps (448 px content in 306 px).
fix: Add a right-edge fade / 'scroll →' hint on overflowing .tw (e.g. background shadow gradient technique), or stack comparison tables into cards under 480 px; keep first column sticky.

where: comp · compensation model select at 1280 px (clinical skin)
what: The 'Primary disorder' select is truncated to 'Metabolic acido' with a wide empty area to its right.
fix: Let the select grow (min-width:14ch / flex:1) or shorten option labels ('Met. acidosis').

what: On phone the 3-column table is 420 px in a 306 px box; the 'Key point' column (the actual teaching) shows only ~55 px before clipping, with no visible scroll cue.
fix: Below 600 px render .tbl rows as stacked cards (Drug as heading, Gas and Key point beneath), or add a right-edge fade/scroll hint on .tw.

what: Units are uppercased: "ML/KG PBW", "CMH₂O", "PACO₂ MMHG". ML means megalitre, and the chemical symbols are corrupted.
fix: Remove text-transform: uppercase from .stats small (use letter-spacing instead), or wrap units in <span style="text-transform:none">.

what: The SVG scales with width, so at 1280 px wide the 320×120 viewBox becomes about 970×365 px: the "30" and "airway pressure, 2 breaths" labels render at about 30 px and the trace dominates the screen. It is a dark-only monitor in the light/clinical skin, which is fine as a monitor look, but the label colour #9fb0c0 is hard-coded.
fix: Use .ventw{max-height:220px} with preserveAspectRatio="none" on the path group (or a wider viewBox at width ≥ 700). Set the label font in px with vector-effect, or render the labels as HTML outside the SVG.

what: The 'Osm (measured)' unit 'mOsm/kg' overflows into the next label, 'BHB (ketones)' ('mOsm/kgBHB').
evidence: 1280×800: the unit span's right edge is 444.7 px and the BHB label starts at 436.2 px. Shot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T11-interp-desk.png
fix: Allow the label to wrap (unit on its own line), shorten it to 'mOsm', or set min-width:0 with overflow:hidden on the unit span.

what: The Next steps card comes after the collapsed 'Formulas, assumptions and limits' card. The clinically useful content sits below the reference table, and the desktop read is very long while the form column ends early.
fix: Order: Read -> Steps -> Next steps -> Formulas. Make the left form column position:sticky on wide screens.

what: The formulas table is 420 px wide inside a 306 px container on a 390 px phone (horizontal scroll inside the card, with no visual cue).
fix: Under 600 px, stack the rows as cards (Quantity as the heading, then the formula, then the limits).

what: Two different components share the class '.spark'. Line 374 styles the Progress session bars (display:flex; height:44px) and line 536 styles the trend SVG (width:100%; height:56px). The later rule makes the Progress bars 56 px tall and full width, and the earlier rule makes the SVG display:flex.
fix: Rename the trend one '.tspark' (ui6.js sparkSVG and shell.html:536).

what: The ⇄ between the two boxes is drawn as a bordered square that looks like a swap button but does nothing.
fix: Drop the border/background on .eq (plain glyph), or make it a real swap button.

what: The normal box (pH 7.35–7.45, HCO₃⁻ 22–26) uses --good-soft, which is #1C2A0B in dark mode and is invisible under the bands. It also has no label or legend entry.
fix: Draw the box with a 1.5 px --good stroke and a small 'normal' label, and add 'Normal' to the .mlegend.

what: The Disorders topic colour is the same orange as --accent, which also marks the selected and linked nodes. When a Disorders node is selected, linked and unlinked Disorders nodes look alike. Topics are also scattered across the layout, so the colour legend shows no clusters.
fix: Give --w-dis a non-accent hue (e.g. magenta). In webLayout, add a weak pull towards each topic's sector centre so topics cluster.

what: Before locking, a second track under the slider repeats the thumb position, so two bars show the same thing. The second one only becomes useful after locking.
fix: Hide .est-track until ES.shown, or merge the answer band into the range input's background.

what: The hidden placeholder (min-height 120px) is taller than the gas tiles (~90px), so the options jump down when the gas hides.
fix: Give .sphidden the same height as .spgas (measure and set inline, or min-height:auto with padding equal to the tile).

what: At 1280 px the printout table stretches the full card width, so values sit far from their names (values ~320 px away), unlike a paper slip.
fix: max-width:34rem on .printout (centre or left), or table width:auto.

what: After answering, all options are dimmed including the right one, so the key you are meant to learn is low-contrast grey (only a thin green outline).
fix: Keep .spo.right at full opacity with a 'Correct' tag/tick; dim only the others.

what: The global .bub chat-bubble rule (padding 8px 12px, 2px border, max-width) also hits the header logo, which is also .bub (.brand .bub), so the logo gets bubble padding and border.
evidence: getComputedStyle(".brand .bub"): padding 8px 12px, border 2px, width 28 px (designed 22 px).
fix: Scope the chat rules to .chat .bub (and .chat .bub.them etc.).

what: The autopsy chip row is centred inside a filled box in the clinical skin but left-aligned in pixel.
fix: Give .autopsy .seg justify-content:flex-start in both skins.

what: Image-led steps without messages render an empty .chat with margin 12px 0, leaving a ~60 px blank gap between the case card and the image.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T21-im-dip-s1-answered1280.png (gap between intro card and dipstick).
fix: Add `.chat:empty{display:none}` or skip the div when hist and st.m are empty.

what: Physical objects (dipstick, syringe) are drawn on the near-black monitor screen (#0d1117) in every theme; in light themes they sit in a black box. The monitor and capnograph rightly look like screens; a dipstick or syringe does not.
fix: Give .img-dip/.img-syr a theme-aware background (var(--card) or a neutral bench grey) and keep the dark screen only for .img-capno/.img-mon.

what: On a 390 px phone (Game mode) the 17 badge tiles stack in a single column, giving about 1,000 px of scrolling.
fix: Use grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr)), or 2 columns under 520 px.

what: Inverted hierarchy on badge tiles: the badge name is in 10 px pixel font and muted, while the description ('Module boss', 'Won 05/11/2026') is larger body text.
fix: Make the name the larger line (body font 0.9rem, bold) and the description the small one.

what: 'Last 4 weeks' is drawn as 2 rows of 14 days that start on an arbitrary weekday, with no weekday or date labels. On desktop the grid fills only the left half of the card (max-width 560 px).
fix: Use a 7-column, Monday-first grid (4–5 rows, matching the week card's Monday start) with M T W T F S S labels and the start date. Let it span the card width or sit beside the streak numbers.

what: The class .spark is defined twice: as the Progress session bar chart (height 44 px) and later for the trends SVG (height 56 px, width 100%). The later rule wins on Progress. The sparkline has no axis or 80%/50% guide, so colour alone carries the meaning.
fix: Rename one of them (e.g. .sessbars) and add a faint 80% guide line plus a text summary ('last 8: 4 strong, 3 weak').

what: The clinical skin's blanket 10 px radius damages pixel-specific elements. The square Buffer logo becomes a lumpy orange blob, the 4-week heat-map squares turn into circles, and the srow divider (border-top) curves up at the ends above 'Reset progress'.
evidence: Clinical-skin screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-sheet-today-learn.png (logo), /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-sheet-session-progress.png (heat map as dots), /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-settings-phone-clinical-light.png (curved divider).
fix: Scope the radius to components (.card, .btn, .chip, .seg, input, select, .tile, .opt) rather than *, and exclude .logo, .heat i and dividers.

what: With the longer slip (Urea/Osm rows), flags and reference ranges wrap onto a second line on a phone ('7.31' / 'L', '7.35–' / '7.45', 'Osm (meas.)'). This makes the printout harder to scan than the compact version.
fix: Shrink the range column, or hide it below 400 px and show the flag inline next to the value with white-space:nowrap.

what: buffer.html has no <!doctype> or <meta charset='utf-8'>; served by a plain static server (python http.server) every ·, ₂, → and emoji turns into mojibake (the PWA index.html does have the charset). (Doubt: the claude.ai artifact wrapper may add it.)
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-chip-today-phone.png show 'Â·' and 'â†' in the header and chip.
fix: Start shell.html with <!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"> (first 1024 bytes).

what: In the clinical skin the back chip keeps the pixel look (square corners, 2px ink border) while the rest of the clinical UI is rounded.
fix: Add [data-skin=clinical] .fromchip{border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.

what: German words have no visual cue that they play sound (all:unset; bold text only). "Tap a German word to hear it" in the header is the only hint, and the desktop says "tap".
fix: Add a small speaker icon after the word (ic("sound") or similar) and a hover underline; change header to "Tap or click".

what: Cards without plural/example vertically centre the word, so in the 4-column desktop grid headwords sit at different heights (e.g. "die Arteria radialis", "das Natrium" are lower than neighbours).
fix: .gl{align-content:start} so rows top-align.

what: At 1280 px the topic chips are centred while search and buttons are left-aligned; the chips are 29 px tall, below a 44 px touch target on phone.
evidence: chip-tap sizes in t26/out.json: height 29 px; screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T26-gloss-1280.png.
fix: Left-align the chip row in .filters and raise chip min-height to 40–44 px on coarse pointers.

what: At 390 px the 76 single-column cards make an 8,400 px page; the "Present a gas" card, the most useful part, is at the very bottom.
fix: Put the "Present a gas" card first or behind its own chip ("Sätze"), and use a compact two-line row layout on phones.

what: Primary small buttons use the pixel font at 10 px, plain small buttons use 13.8 px bold body text. Side by side they look like two different systems: 'Hand over' next to 'Pause / Wait 5 min', 'Play' next to 'Step', 'Save' next to 'Cancel', 'Drill Consistency check'. The primary is visually the weakest label in the row.
fix: Give `.btn.primary.small` 11px pixel with min-height 44 and the same padding as .btn.small, and use the pixel font at 11–12 px for all small buttons (or body font for all). Keep one rule.

what: Settings Quiet mode is also a native blue checkbox, the only native control left in an otherwise styled page.
fix: Apply the same pixel checkbox style globally: `input[type=checkbox]{appearance:none;width:22px;height:22px;border:2px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--raise)} input[type=checkbox]:checked{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}` plus a tick.

what: The clinical skin keeps several pixel-only treatments: hard offset shadows on .hero, .slip, .bigscore, .flashcard and .brand .bub; the zig-zag tear under .slip; and `*{border-radius:10px!important}` rounds things that should stay square or become pills (progress pips, .xpbar, heat-map cells, .qn, inner .seg buttons each rounded inside a rounded group).
fix: Replace the blanket radius with a scoped list (.card,.btn,.tile,.opt,.inp,.sheet,.seg → 10px; .seg button → 8px; pips/bars/heat cells → 2px), and add `html[data-skin=clinical] .hero,.slip,.bigscore,.flashcard{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}`.

what: Glossary cards stretch to the row height and their grid spreads the extra space, so the German word sits at different heights in neighbouring cards ('die Spritze', 'die Arteria radialis' float to the middle). The cards also skip the app's .card bevel and notch.
fix: `.gl{align-content:start}` and add the .card class (or its bevel box-shadow) to .gl.

what: In the dark theme the heat-map scale is out of order: l1 (--accent-soft #431407) is almost the same as an empty cell, and l2 (--hi #FDBA74, pale peach) is brighter and more eye-catching than l3 (--accent #F97316), so busy days look less busy than medium days.
fix: Use a monotonic ramp in dark: l1 #7C2D12, l2 #C2410C, l3 #F97316 (and keep today's outline).

what: Long questions are set in the pixel font: boss questions (.gymq, two to three lines), case prompts (.ask, accent 12 px), the teach-back prompt and Final check 'What is the read?'. Multi-line pixel text is hard to read and inconsistent with session questions, which use the body font.
fix: Keep the pixel font for the eyebrow only and set question text in the body font at 1.05rem bold, like .qblock h3.

what: The four sheets differ: the hand-kit and builder sheets have a grab handle and a 10 px pixel <b> title; the 4.3 save sheet and 4.9 OCR sheet have no handle and an 18 px h2. Inputs in these sheets (.fld input, background var(--bg)) differ from the interpreter inputs (.inp, background var(--raise)).
fix: Give all sheets the same header (grab + h2 at 16 px pixel) and use one input style: `.fld input,.fld textarea{background:var(--raise)}`.

what: The session bar sticks at top:56px but the header is 62 px tall, so the top 6 px of the bar slide under the header when scrolling.
evidence: startSession('steps'), scroll 500 px at 390×844: header bottom 62, .sbar top 56.
fix: Use a shared variable: `--hdr:62px` on :root, `.sbar{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + var(--hdr))}` and the same for .side and .stick.

what: minmax(180px,1fr) gives one input per row inside a 306 px card at 390 px, so short numeric fields (pH, PCO₂, rate, weight) each take a full row and the results are below the fold on every tool.
fix: Use minmax(130px,1fr) for numeric tools (or the existing .ctrls.tight), keeping selects full width with grid-column:1/-1.

what: `.vig{margin:0;font-style:italic}` (line 548) makes every vignette in sessions, cases and drills italic, including three-line vignettes. Long italic text is harder to read, and the original style was upright.
fix: Scope the italic to speed drills (`.spcard .vig`) or drop it.

what: 'Hand over' (ends the sim) is the primary orange button at t = 0, next to Pause and Wait. It is easy to end the run by mistake on a touch screen.
fix: Style it as a secondary button, move it to the far right, and ask for confirmation before t ≥ 10′.

what: At 1440 and 1920 the 1040 px column uses 54–72% of the width; Today and Progress are long single columns with large side margins.
fix: At ≥1400 px widen .wrap to 1240 px and give Today a two-column layout (Round + plan left; Gas of the day + mastery right). Progress can put heat map, accuracy and autopsy side by side.

what: Most bugs here are CSS class collisions from later versions (.bub, .wrap, .eq, .hrow, .autopsy, .vig, .spark, .pocket redefined).
evidence: Harness: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/t28/run.py (66 views × any viewport/skin/theme, with an overflow, clipped-text and tiny-text audit).
fix: Add a build-time check in build.py that warns when a class selector is defined twice in shell.html, and keep a screenshot run of the 66 views in the tests folder.

what: Old and new features use different building blocks for the same job: .opt vs .spo vs .act buttons; .ro vs .stats vs .spgas readouts; .card vs .gl vs .fb boxes.
fix: Write a short component list in shell.html's header comment (answer button, readout tile, info card, sheet) and move 4.3–4.9 markup onto it.
